site: Gmail in the agent's own browser
class: A mailbox was chosen by position (the first signed-in Google account) instead of by the address the job accounts use
symptom: The agent's browser had an older Google login in it, so the sign-in page continued as that account and the owner could not add the account the job accounts use; and the mail readers searched whichever account came first.
root_cause: Every Gmail reader opened mail.google.com/mail/u/0/ (the first account) and never checked it was the applying account; the sign-in helper opened Google's plain sign-in, which continues as an already signed-in account.
why_tests_missed: No test used a browser holding more than one Google account, and the address form was never tried against real Gmail before it shipped: a unit test of the string cannot show that Gmail rejects it.
fix: _gmail_search_url opens https://mail.google.com/mail/?authuser=<ats email>#search/... (a plain mailbox address only; else the first account), used by all three readers; the helper opens Google's AddSession page so the job account can be added next to an existing login. The first version used /mail/u/<address>/, which real Gmail answers with 'Temporary Error' (found the same day by opening it in the agent's browser); authuser= was checked against real Gmail.
prevention: Pick a mailbox by its address, never by position; and make the one-time sign-in step able to add an account, not only continue as an existing one. Try every new external address form against the real service once before relying on it.
